title: Farmhouse Upgrades - Stardew Valley Guide - IGN
costHits: The first farmhouse upgrade costs 10,000g and requires 450 wood.
The second farmhouse upgrade costs 65,000g and requires 100 hardwood.
The second farmhouse upgrade 65,000g and requires 100 hardwood. After three days, your renovation is complete!
Open Bedroom	Removes the wall separating your bedroom and the entrance room.	10,000g
Add Cubby	Adds a little cubby next to the front door.	10,000g
The third and final major upgrade Robin can make adds a cellar to your house. As Robin explains it: "The cellar can be used to age certain products, like wine and cheese. It will cost 100,000g."

When the upgrade is complete you'll have a doorway on the south wall of your kitchen that leads into the cellar. Below you'll find rows of brown casks that do not produce new projects, but instead age products. You can add artisanal goods like beer, wine, and cheese to improve their quality.
